note: Missing handle — a claim must name the reservation it claims.
handle with characters outside unpadded base64url (padding `=`) must be rejected; VTI-LNK-033 fixes the alphabet.
handle shorter than 16 bytes (22 characters) must be rejected.

Unknown member — additionalProperties: false rejects a claimant-supplied administrator DID. The administrator is the envelope's issuer (VTI-LNK-113), never a payload member, so a Farm cannot be talked into writing a key that did not sign the claim.
A response without vtaDid tells the wallet nothing it can act on.
operation is a closed lowerCamelCase list (SPEC §4.10); the snake_case spelling is rejected.

The response carries no claim check — additionalProperties: false rejects one. The wallet computes the check from its own key (VTI-LNK-115); a Farm-supplied value would let a wallet show a check it did not derive.
A progress URL with userinfo is rejected; a credential belongs in neither a URL nor a log line.
